actual_bill: unknown; estimates use peak tariff and successful-response usage, including empty-content diagnosis
default_thinking_failure: Reasoning consumed 256/512 output budget; empty content had incorrectly counted as task success
concurrency_confound: workers=1 gets 1CPU admission budget, workers=2 gets 2CPU; remote cache, run order and model variation not controlled
ready_wait: Observed admission event time minus latest successful dependency event; root tasks use controller creation time, not kernel scheduler wait
resource_scope: Local Agent/tool Workers; excludes provider compute and model-broker control process. Memory is sampled concurrent model-worker max combined with tool cgroup peak, not guaranteed true global peak
cache_ablation: fixed real outputs replay, sequential logical readers and actual tests, not fresh model calls
independent_test_boundary: heldout not sent to model, but this is a constructed 3-function task, not arbitrary repository repair
